0022600216.text: The Thunder (8-2, 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West) arrive on a four-game winning streak and a 3-2 road record, while the Trail Blazers (6-3, 3rd in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, 8th in the West) have lost their last two games. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), and Robert Williams III is day-to-day with rest as the reason and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 124-95 win in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025.
